title: SynthTextEval: Synthetic Text Data Generation and Evaluation for High-Stakes Domains

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating group fairness metrics, specifically Equalized Odds (EO) and Equality Difference (ED) such as False Negative Equality Difference (FNED), on downstream classification tasks (e.g., ICD-9 code prediction) trained on synthetic data across different patient race subgroups.
